name: AI request, no problem
text: We want an AI chatbot on our website so we look modern. Budget $500.

name: Real problem, no AI mention
text: Our two receptionists write every booking in a paper diary and then re-type it into Excel each evening, about 40 bookings a day. Mistakes cause double bookings. Need someone to fix this.

name: One-off manual task
text: Please enter 500 business cards into a spreadsheet. One time job, due Friday.

name: Recurring, no economic impact
text: Every Monday I copy last week's sales figures from Shopify into a Google Sheet. Looking for a script.

name: High impact, not automatable
text: Our surgeons spend 6 hours daily negotiating with families about treatment choices and we lose 10 patients monthly. Need a better process.

name: Automatable, weak evidence
text: We sometimes get lots of emails and want to automate replies somehow.

name: Same problem, different wording A
text: Staff manually call every new lead that comes from our Facebook ads, around 20 a day, usually the next morning.

name: Same problem, different wording B
text: Sales reps chase incoming enquiries by phone. Prospects often go cold before anyone replies. We get roughly 100 per week.

name: Different problems, similar wording
text: We manually qualify every inbound lead against a checklist, 15 per day, which takes our manager 2 hours.

name: Multiple problems in one post
text: Every day I reconcile 60 payments by hand (3 hours). Separately, each new client onboarding needs me to email 8 documents manually, 10 clients a month.

name: Problem described as solution
text: I need a Zapier flow connecting Typeform to Gmail.

name: Duplicate across clients (copy-paste)
text: Same text as adv07 posted by a different client id.

expect.dedupe: near_dup_flag_by_shingles; counts as 1 only if same client_key else flagged copied_template, counted once in unique_clients_with_note

name: Client reposting
text: Same text as adv07, same client, 5 days later.

name: Vague post
text: Need help with business automation. Open to ideas.

name: Extremely detailed post
text: [3000-word SOP describing 12 steps of order handling with one stated pain: step 7 takes 4 hours weekly]

name: Industry jargon
text: Our no-show rate on hygiene recalls is 18% because the front desk calls patients by hand, about 200 a month.

name: Cause behind problem
text: Orders arrive by WhatsApp and nobody has time to enter them, so we enter them next day, about 30 a day.

name: Consequence not merged
text: Late invoice chasing means cash flow is delayed by 3 weeks. We chase 30 invoices a month by hand.

name: Tool mentioned, no pain
text: We use HubSpot and Slack. Need a developer to build a custom dashboard widget.

name: Human labor replacement
text: Hiring a part-time virtual assistant to send appointment reminders to about 50 clients daily and log replies in our sheet.
